Cefprozil can interfere with the effectiveness of live bacterial vaccines, such as the typhoid vaccine. 3. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if it is clearly necessary, as determined by your healthcare provider. 4. This medication passes into breast milk, so consult your doctor before breastfeeding. 5. Drug interactions can alter the way your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. 6. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Keep a detailed list of all the products you use, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, and herbal supplements, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. 7. Cefprozil may interfere with certain laboratory tests, such as diabetic urine tests or blood glucose tests, potentially causing inaccurate results. 8. In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms like loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911 in the U.S.) immediately. For non-emergency overdoses, contact a poison control center. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. 9. This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current condition and should not be used for other purposes without consulting your doctor. 10. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. 11. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. 12. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. 13. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this medication and your specific health needs. 14. Cefprozil is a cephalosporin antibiotic used to treat a variety of bacterial infections. It is not effective against viral infections, such as the common cold or flu. 15. Take this medication orally as directed by your doctor, usually once or twice daily. It can be taken with food if stomach upset occurs. 16. The dosage is based on your medical condition and response to treatment. For optimal results, take this antibiotic at evenly spaced intervals. 17. Continue taking this medication for the full prescribed duration, even if symptoms improve after a few days. Stopping the medication too early may allow bacteria to continue growing, potentially leading to a relapse of the infection. 18. Common side effects include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, or dizziness. If these effects persist or worsen, inform your doctor promptly. 19. Rarely, this medication may cause a severe intestinal condition (Clostridium difficile-associated diarrhea) due to resistant bacteria. This condition can occur during treatment or weeks to months after treatment has stopped. 20. Prolonged or repeated use of this medication may result in oral thrush or a new vaginal yeast infection. Notify your doctor if you notice white patches in your mouth, a change in vaginal discharge, or other new symptoms. 21. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare but may include rash, itching/swelling (especially of the face/tongue/throat), severe dizziness, or trouble breathing. Seek immediate medical attention if these occur. 22. Before taking cefprozil, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to penicillins, or to other cephalosporin antibiotics (e.g., cephalexin), or if you have any other allergies. 23. This product may contain inactive ingredients that can cause allergic reactions or other problems. Discuss this with your healthcare provider. 24. This medication may cause dizziness. Alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can intensify this effect. Avoid driving, using machinery, or performing tasks requiring alertness until you can do so safely. 25. Limit alcoholic beverages while taking this medication. 26. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete and personalized advice regarding this medication and your health.
